title: The Illusion of Rationality: Tacit Bias and Strategic Dominance in Frontier LLM Negotiation Games

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-turn bargaining games (Buyer-Seller scenario) via self-play and calculating the Spearman rank correlation between the normalized initial proposal and the final price to measure numerical anchoring. It also analyzes the mapping of internal valuations to initial proposals to identify semantic anchoring (clustering around salient price points).
